description:
Low finding from the 2808 review (re-verify): _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/protocol.py encode_marker drops patch_map and then summary but can still exceed MARKER_LIMIT (4,096 characters), then raises MarkerError, so report.finalize aborts and no status, review or retry state is written. The reviewer built it from three valid findings with 199-character CJK paths and 200-character titles.

DECISION GATE: do not silently drop findings. Choose a fail-soft that keeps the verdict and decision: trim long titles/paths inside the marker record deterministically (the visible review body keeps the full text), or store only finding ids and digests in the marker; the marker must still parse back to the decision, strikes and carried defects needed by later rounds. If a later round needs fields that cannot fit, record that as a limit and fail closed with an explicit pending state rather than an exception that loses the review.

GUARDRAILS: never post a stand-in or any oracle comment; never rerun the oracle; oracle verdict required on the PR (soundness path _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers); no pre-registered digests; never weaken a gate; no skip/xfail; primary clone read-only (make worktree-create, absolute worktree paths, no git stash, no git add -A, identity Joe Harris); no CHANGELOG entry; no code comments/docstrings; PR text for a reader who never saw the session; never close/label/edit gap issues; done = merged PR plus evidence.
